cards.front: What is the average and worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
cards.back:
Average: O(n log n)
Worst case: O(n²) (when pivot is repeatedly chosen poorly, e.g., smallest or largest on sorted data).

cards.front: What is the time and space complexity of MergeSort?
cards.back:
Time: O(n log n) in all cases (best, average, worst).
Space: O(n) auxiliary space for merging arrays.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Binary Search?
cards.back:
Time: O(log n) on sorted arrays.
Space: O(1) iterative, O(log n) recursive call stack.

cards.front: What are the average and worst-case complexities of Hash Table lookup?
cards.back:
Average: O(1) constant time.
Worst case: O(n) if all elements collide into the same bucket (or O(log n) in Java 8+ TreeMap buckets).

cards.front: What is the time complexity of BFS and DFS on a graph with V vertices and E edges?
cards.back:
Time: O(V + E) using adjacency list.
Space: O(V) for visited set and queue/stack.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Dijkstra's Algorithm using a Min-Heap?
cards.back:
Time: O((V + E) log V).
Space: O(V) for distance table and priority queue.

cards.front: What is the time complexity to insert into a Balanced BST (AVL or Red-Black Tree)?
cards.back:
Time: O(log n) for search + tree rotations.
Space: O(1) auxiliary.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Heapify operation to build a Binary Heap of n elements?
cards.back: Time: O(n) linear time (using bottom-up build-heap sift-down approach), not O(n log n).

cards.front: What is the time complexity of finding a cycle in a Linked List using Floyd's Tortoise and Hare?
cards.back:
Time: O(n) linear time.
Space: O(1) constant auxiliary space.

cards.front: What is the time and space complexity of Kadane's Algorithm for Maximum Subarray Sum?
cards.back:
Time: O(n) single pass.
Space: O(1) variables for maxSoFar and maxEndingHere.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of the 0/1 Knapsack problem with n items and capacity W?
cards.back:
Time: O(n * W) pseudo-polynomial time.
Space: O(W) with 1D DP space optimization.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of the KMP String Matching Algorithm for text of length N and pattern M?
cards.back:
Time: O(N + M) (O(M) to precompute LPS table, O(N) for search).
Space: O(M) for LPS array.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Topological Sort using Kahn's Algorithm?
cards.back:
Time: O(V + E) using in-degree array and queue.
Space: O(V) for queue and in-degree tracking.

cards.front: What is the space complexity of quicksort in practice?
cards.back: Space: O(log n) average auxiliary space for the recursive call stack.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Union-Find (Disjoint Set) with Path Compression and Union by Rank?
cards.back: Time: O(α(n)) amortized per operation, where α is the Inverse Ackermann function (effectively constant, ≤ 4).

cards.front: What is the difference between Array and Linked List access vs insertion?
cards.back:
Array: O(1) random index access, O(n) insert/delete in middle.
Linked List: O(n) access by index, O(1) insert/delete once node pointer is known.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of reversing a singly linked list?
cards.back:
Time: O(n) single pass through all nodes.
Space: O(1) using prev, curr, and next pointers.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Bellman-Ford algorithm and its main advantage over Dijkstra?
cards.back:
Time: O(V * E).
Advantage: Can handle negative edge weights and detect negative weight cycles.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of Matrix Multiplication (standard vs Strassen)?
cards.back:
Standard: O(n³)
Strassen's: ~O(n^2.81)
Space: O(1) auxiliary for standard.

cards.front: What is the time complexity of finding the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) in a Binary Tree?
cards.back:
Time: O(n) traversing tree nodes.
Space: O(h) recursive call stack where h is tree height.
